description: Antenas de telefonía móvil de Cerdanyola del Vallès is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cerdanyola.cat. Cerdanyola del Vallès mobile phone antennas is a set of geographical information regarding the location of the installation points of the antennas that supply mobile coverage to the municipality. The spatial representation of this data is carried out by means of an interactive viewer. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Cerdanyola del Vallès mobile phone antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Catalunya, Telecomunicacions, Municipality, Cataluña, Salut pública, Espanya. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
